## Sweater cloud source → verified import

00:00 Asia/Riyadh; previous seven completed service days. Browserbase reads every individual and B2B page plus booking event details. Customer data is excluded. The platform reuses only established stable biker links. Missing or conflicting links remain reviewable.

Validation mode calls preview only. Production mode runs the existing atomic import workflow separately for each batch of at most 100 records, then requires verification for every batch. No collection, payroll payment or ledger posting.

A logged-out source, changed page contract, failed function or incomplete coverage stops before import. Refresh SSP login manually in the saved Browserbase Context when needed. Never start concurrent source runs with the same Context.
